title: Wɔn a Wɔahyɛ Wɔn Bɔ
intro: Odiyifo bi a wobu no nantew nnipa no mu, frɛɛ wɔn kɔɔ nokware no mu. Nnipa pii danee wɔn ho wɔ atirimɔden so, nanso kuw ketewaa bi a wɔatu wɔn ho ama gyee ɔfrɛ no na wofi wɔn koma nyinaa mu hyɛɛ bɔ. Wɔde adwenem naayɛ sɔɔ wɔn hwɛe na wonyaa akokoduru hwehwɛɛ ɔsoro aduan. Wɔn ahofama a enhinhim no bɛyɛɛ gyidi ho asuade a bere ntumi nsɛe no. Ná wɔyɛ henanom?
clues: Na yɛyɛ kuw ketewa bi a yɛsɔre boaa ɔsoro asɛmpatrɛw adwuma bi wɔ bere a na nnipa pii nni gyidi mu.
Dkɔmhyɛni bi a wobu no baa hɔ bɛfrɛɛ yɛn sɛ yennyina sɛ ayɔnkofo wɔ Allah kwan so.
Bere a odiyifo no bisae sɛ henanom na wɔbɛyɛ Ɔsorofo no akyigyinafo no, yebuae a yɛantwentwɛn yɛn nan ase.
Yɛde akokoduru srɛɛ anwonwakwan so apontow bi a wɔsomaa fi soro brɛɛ yɛn koma den.
Yɛn nkɔmhyɛni no kaee yɛn sɛ sɛ yɛyɛ agyidifoɔ nokorɛ a, yɛmfa nidi mma Allah, nanso wɔdii yɛn ahobrɛaseɛ abisadeɛ no ni.
Na yɛyɛ emufo kuw a wɔatu wɔn ho ama a yɛhyɛɛ gyidi a enhinhim ho bɔ wɔ Isa, Maryam ba no nkyɛn.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
